description: Recommendation-decision scenarios authored on 2026-10-21 before the evidence matcher was calibrated. Labels are agent-authored engineering judgments against evaluation/retrieval/catalogue.json, not HEDGE-approved relevance labels. complete = documents every requested function; partial = documents part of it (may be mentioned as a partial fit, never recommended as complete); forbidden = must not be recommended.
